variation: Forearm plank with knee-supported entry/exit, extended legs and a timed hold. Not push-ups or repeated hip lifts.
camera: Fixed low side three-quarter, head left and feet right; both forearms and both toes visible.
intentionalMovement: Knees lift for hold and lower on exit.
Shoes pivot and legs extend during entry; do not mistake intended shoe rotation for fixed pixel geometry.
Forearms and elbows remain planted across the entire sequence.

muscles.note: Qualitative hierarchy. Deep core muscles are not rendered through skin.

frames.label: Set forearms
frames.cue: Place elbows beneath shoulders; rest your knees.
frames.state: Knees grounded, forearms flat, elbows beneath shoulders, toes tucked.

frames.label: Brace first
frames.cue: Brace your abs before lifting your knees.
frames.state: Same supported setup; establish abdominal tension before lifting.

frames.label: Extend and lift
frames.cue: Extend legs; lift knees from the floor.
frames.state: Full forearm plank on toes and forearms; straight head-to-heel line.

frames.label: Find your line
frames.cue: Keep head, hips and heels aligned.
frames.state: Same full plank; no hip sag, pike or head tilt.

frames.label: Hold and breathe
frames.cue: Hold for time while breathing normally.
frames.state: Same full plank, sustained isometric hold for the prescribed duration. Demo cadence is not the exercise duration.

frames.label: Lower knees
frames.cue: Finish your hold; lower your knees gently.
frames.state: Return to the original knee-supported setup with control.

reuseRationale: A timed isometric hold does not require invented motion. Setup and brace share one joint configuration; lift/align/hold share the full-plank position; exit returns to setup. Each slot has a separate source file.
